reviews.text:
Bought a years subscription to this app after watching constant ads on You Tube about how brilliantly the app identifies plant problems  and offers suitable remedy
Immediately took it to a struggling cutting that i hoped was a lost blueberry rooted cutting, recently found in heavy undergrowth,  which i then moved to new site.  
Plant AI said it was Japanese knotweed!
i tried again
Plant AI said it was African milk bush
I tried again. Plant AI said it could not identify the plant over and over again
I tried to diagnose the plant
The app wanted me to buy another app which could not identify either

i tried the 2 free apps
Plant finder said it was Sacred Bamboo although did identify a pear tree also struggling in what i hoped would be a fruit hedge
Plant Net agreed that it was a blueberry

reviews.title: Less than one star
reviews.text: The App could not identify my garden plants, it kept shutting down after I snapped a photo, and it would not let me connect to my iPhone email to ask for help.  Save your money, very disappointed!!!

reviews.title: Terrible App
reviews.text: I downloaded this app when I was on a job and was having trouble identifying a few plants. I attempted to identify 3 different plants and it didn’t identify any correctly. I then attempted to identify another bush and it identified it incorrectly. 4 times in a row so I gave up on it and used google. I had already paid the 1 year subscription, I attempted to cancel it and Apple would refund me. Told me I had to contact the App creator. I didn’t have time and forgot.  I threw away $20 for nothing and never received a refund. I won’t recommend this app until this can be fixed!
